== Biography ==
William P. Glasgow was born in 1813 in Wythe County, Virginia, USA.<ref name="FindWPG">[http://www.findagrave.com/cgi-bin/fg.cgi?page=gr&GRid=35918642 Find A Grave Memorial# 35918642 William P. Glasgow]</ref>

He married Levicia Patterson, daughter of Thomas Patterson and Anne Leedy<ref name="FindWPG"/> probably about 1839 in Wythe County, Virginia.

He and Levicia appeared on the census of 26 July 1850 at Wythe County, Virginia.<ref name="1850 US Census">Year: 1850; Census Place: District 68, Wythe, Virginia; Roll: M432_982; Page: 249A; Image: 94 [http://search.ancestry.com/cgi-bin/sse.dll?db=1850usfedcenancestry&indiv=try&h=15647165 1850 US Census. William Glasgow]</ref>  He and Levicia appeared on the census of 14 June 1860 at Wythe County, Virginia.  His mother-in-law was living with them.<ref name="1860 US CensusWG">Year: 1860; Census Place: District 68, Wythe, Virginia; Roll: M653_1385; Page: 770; Image: 127; Family History Library Film: 805385 [http://search.ancestry.com/cgi-bin/sse.dll?db=1860usfedcenancestry&indiv=try&h=33881437 1860 US Census 	William P Glasgoe]</ref>  He and Levicia appeared on the census of 21 June 1870 at Washington, Warren County, Iowa.<ref name="1870 US Census">Year: 1870; Census Place: Washington, Warren, Iowa; Roll: M593_423; Page: 476B; Image: 282188; Family History Library Film: 545922 [http://search.ancestry.com/cgi-bin/sse.dll?db=1870usfedcen&indiv=try&h=20388785 1870 US Census. William Glasgow]</ref>

William died sometime between 1870 and 1880 probably in Story County, Iowa, Levicia is a widow in the 1880 census, and was buried at [[:Category: Patterson Memorial Cemetery, Fort Chiswell, Virginia|Patterson Memorial Cemetery]], Fort Chiswell, Wythe County, Virginia.  His [http://www.findagrave.com/cgi-bin/fg.cgi?page=gr&GRid=35918642 memorial] has a link to that of Levicia.<ref name="FindWPG"/>
